Learn.title: Learn for your Class 7 test
Learn.subtitle: 9 topics. Read a lesson, then practise the questions.
Learn.readyBody: Practise the questions for this topic to check what you have learned.

topics.license-information: Understand the GDL stages, tests and demerit points
topics.road-signs: Recognise signs by shape, colour and symbol
topics.traffic-lights-and-signals: Know what lights, arrows and road lines tell you to do
topics.intersections-and-turns: Decide who goes first and turn correctly
topics.basics-of-driving: Start, steer, stop and park safely
topics.share-the-road: Stay safe around pedestrians, cyclists, trucks and buses
topics.highway-driving: Merge, pass and keep a safe distance at speed
topics.responsible-driving: Avoid distraction, impairment and common offences
topics.emergency-conditions: Handle skids, breakdowns, bad weather and collisions

MockExam.title: Mock Exam
MockExam.answerAll: Please answer all questions before submitting.
MockExam.confirmBody: You won't be able to change your answers after submitting.
MockExam.submitError: Could not submit the exam. Please try again.
MockExam.subtitle: A practice version of the knowledge test: timed, with questions from every topic.
MockExam.lockedBody: Master every topic in Practice to unlock the mock exam.
MockExam.rule1: Questions come from all {topics} topics, weighted like the real test.
MockExam.rule2: You can go back and change any answer before you submit.
MockExam.rule3: The exam submits itself when the time runs out.
MockExam.passedBody: Great work. You are ready for the real knowledge test.
MockExam.failedBody: You need {pass} correct to pass. Review your mistakes, practise, and try again.
MockExam.noMistakes: No mistakes to review. Well done!
MockExam.notAnswered: You did not answer this question.
